summary: Built temporal/state-change reasoning over KB note nodes (Zep gap). validFrom/validTo + supersedes/supersededBy on notes; supersedeNote() stamps old.validTo & chains both ways WITHOUT deleting history; search_knowledge gains as_of (fact current at a past instant) + history; new supersede_note tool + record_decision supersedes/valid_from; dashboard dims superseded notes (🕓) + purple-dashed supersede link. Files: lib/overlay.js, daemon.js, lib/mcp-core.js, public/graph.html, test/temporal-knowledge.test.js, bench/temporal/. Tested: temporal 16/16, regressions green (search-knowledge 5/5, autowire 15/15, weighted-edges/native-write/repo-target), end-to-end HTTP against an isolated daemon (port 8799, temp data dir) — supersede/as-of/chain all correct. Bench recall@k/MRR-compatible: temporal recall@5=1.0/MRR=1.0 vs latest-only baseline 0.6/0.6. Also fixed a latent note-id millisecond collision. Committed to branch feat/temporal-kb (worktree) — HELD for merge, NOT merged to main.
